model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for four different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the three domains, arranged in alphabetical order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks and labels at regular intervals of 0.5 percentage points. Each domain contains four bars, each corresponding to one of the four models, distinguished by unique color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection is depicted with solid blue, GRPO with diagonal hatching in light orange, PPO+Self-reflection with solid green, and PPO with diagonal hatching in light green. The bars are arranged side-by-side within each domain, with no stacking or grouping, allowing for direct visual comparison of the models’ performance within each domain. The height of each bar corresponds to the accuracy value for that model in that domain, with the highest bars reaching approximately 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection in the Physics domain and approximately 60% for SRPO in the same domain, while the lowest bars reach approximately 53% for DAPO+Self-reflection in the Mathverse domain. No additional visual emphasis, such as highlighting or color coding, is applied to any specific bar beyond the inherent color and pattern distinctions used to differentiate the models.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图旨在比较五种不同方法（DAPO+Self-reflection、DAPO、PPO+Self-reflection、SRPO、PPO）在三个不同评估基准（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）上的准确率（Accuracy (%)）。图表的水平轴（X轴）列出了这三个评估基准，从左至右依次为Mathverse、MMLU和Physics，无特定排序。垂直轴（Y轴）表示准确率百分比，刻度从50到62，以0.5为间隔，采用线性刻度。每个评估基准下包含五根柱状图，分别对应五种方法，颜色和图案区分：DAPO+Self-reflection为蓝色实心，DAPO为浅蓝色斜线，PPO+Self-reflection为绿色实心，SRPO为橙色实心，PPO为浅绿色斜线。在Mathverse基准上，DAPO+Self-reflection（约56.1%）和SRPO（约55.9%）的柱状图高度接近，DAPO（约53.1%）最低，PPO+Self-reflection（约54.1%）和PPO（约53.5%）居中。在MMLU基准上，DAPO+Self-reflection（约57.0%）和SRPO（约57.1%）高度接近，DAPO（约56.0%）和PPO+Self-reflection（约56.1%）略低，PPO（约54.5%）最低。在Physics基准上，DAPO+Self-reflection（约61.2%）最高，SRPO（约61.0%）次之，DAPO（约57.7%）居中，PPO+Self-reflection（约58.0%）和PPO（约57.0%）较低。所有柱状图均无视觉强调，如阴影或加粗轮廓，且无额外注释。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, PPO, and GRPO—across three distinct datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is scaled linearly from 50 to 62, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5 percentage points. The horizontal axis lists the three datasets in order from left to right. Each dataset has five bars, one for each model, distinguished by color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (light gray with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), PPO (light green with diagonal stripes), and GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes). For the Mathverse dataset, the bars show accuracies of approximately 53% for DAPO, 53.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.5% for GRPO, 54% for PPO, and 54.5% for PPO+Self-reflection. In the MMLU dataset, the accuracies are approximately 56% for DAPO, 56.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for GRPO, 54.5% for PPO, and 55% for PPO+Self-reflection. For the Physics dataset, the accuracies are approximately 58% for DAPO, 61.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58% for GRPO, 61% for PPO, and 57% for PPO+Self-reflection. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model legend, with no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit in Prozent für vier verschiedene Modelle – DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO – auf drei verschiedenen Aufgabenbereichen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse listet die drei Aufgabenbereiche in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU und Physics auf, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 skaliert ist, mit einem Tick-Intervall von 2 Prozentpunkten. Jeder Aufgabenbereich zeigt vier gruppierte Balken, wobei die Farben und Muster aus der Legende identifiziert werden: DAPO+Self-reflection ist hellblau mit diagonalen Streifen, GRPO ist hellorange mit diagonalen Streifen, PPO+Self-reflection ist hellgrün mit diagonalen Streifen und PPO ist hellgrün mit diagonalen Streifen. In jedem Aufgabenbereich sind die Balken in der Reihenfolge der Legende angeordnet und nicht sortiert. Die Balken sind nicht hervorgehoben, sondern gleichmäßig dargestellt. Für Mathverse beträgt die Genauigkeit von DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 56,1%, GRPO etwa 53,6%, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 53,4% und PPO etwa 53,4%. Für MMLU beträgt die Genauigkeit von DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 57,0%, GRPO etwa 55,9%, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 54,5% und PPO etwa 54,5%. Für Physics beträgt die Genauigkeit von DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 61,4%, GRPO etwa 58,2%, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 58,1% und PPO etwa 57,1%.
